items.raw_excerpt: Lundy is in "real jeopardy" and could be evacuated if supplies run out, bosses say.
items.summary_en: Lundy is a small island in England. It is known for its puffins and few residents. The island may close or be evacuated if its water supply runs out.

items.raw_excerpt: The hoiho/yellow eyed penguin could be extinct in less than a decade as a respiratory disease continues to wipe out a significant proportion of the chick population on the mainland.
items.summary_en: A breathing disease is killing many yellow-eyed penguin chicks. The hoiho could be gone in less than ten years. Scientists are racing to make a vaccine.
items.summary_ko: 호이호라고도 불리는 노란눈펭귄 새끼들이 호흡기 질환으로 많이 죽고 있다. 이 펭귄은 10년 안에 사라질 수도 있다. 과학자들은 백신을 만들기 위해 서두르고 있다.
items.title_en: Race to Save the Yellow-Eyed Penguin
items.title_ko: 노란눈펭귄을 구하려는 백신 경쟁
items.title_original: Race for vaccine to save hoiho/yellow eyed penguin

items.summary_en: Antofagasta will host Universidad de Chile in the first leg of the Copa Chile quarterfinals. The home team hopes to score first and take an early lead in the series. The match will be played in Antofagasta.

items.raw_excerpt: Five Australian inventions will soon feature on $1 coins as part of the Royal Australian Mint's new Bright Ideas collection.
items.summary_en: The Royal Australian Mint will release new $1 coins. Each coin shows a famous Australian invention. The collection is called Bright Ideas.

items.summary_en: A pub landlord had to close his pub. He says more pubs will close too unless taxes are cut. He feels sad about losing the pub.

items.raw_excerpt: A review that began with suspicions surrounding a single Austrian citizenship application has now expanded to 11 cases linked to the same former provincial employee. Find out how the case began, what is being investigated and what questions remain unanswered.
items.summary_en: A review started with questions about one Austrian citizenship application. It has now grown to 11 cases tied to the same former provincial employee. Officials are checking how the case began and what questions still remain.
items.summary_ko: 한 건의 오스트리아 시민권 신청을 둘러싼 의혹에서 시작된 조사가 같은 전직 주정부 직원과 관련된 11건으로 커졌다. 당국은 이 사건이 어떻게 시작됐는지와 아직 풀리지 않은 의문점을 살펴보고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Novelist Anjet Daanje has been tipped as a serious contender for the Nobel prize in literature and, from her 2022 work The Song of Stork and Dromedary, for very good reason. Published in Dutch as Het lied van ooievaar en dromedaris, the book is loosely based on the life of Emily Brontë, the author of Wuthering Heights. The work opens in 1847, with a villager laying out the body of Eliza May Drayden, who, like Brontë, has written a book...
items.summary_en: A Dutch writer, Anjet Daanje, is seen as a strong pick for the Nobel prize in literature. Her 2022 book is based on the life of Emily Bronte, who wrote Wuthering Heights. The story opens in 1847 with a villager preparing a dead woman's body.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 작가 안옛 단여가 노벨 문학상의 강력한 후보로 꼽힌다. 그녀의 2022년 작품은 《폭풍의 언덕》을 쓴 에밀리 브론테의 삶을 바탕으로 한다. 이야기는 1847년, 한 마을 주민이 죽은 여성의 시신을 정리하는 장면에서 시작한다.
items.title_en: A Dutch Novel Tipped for the Nobel Prize

items.title_original: The Song of Stork and Dromedary: Nobel worthy

items.raw_excerpt: Two elusive fin whales have been photographed by drone as the rare species migrate north along WA's South West coastline.
items.summary_en: Researchers used a drone to photograph two rare fin whales. The whales were migrating north along Western Australia's South West coast. The team called the sighting a special moment.
items.summary_ko: 연구진이 드론으로 희귀 핀고래 두 마리를 촬영했다. 이 고래들은 호주 서부 서남부 해안을 따라 북쪽으로 이동 중이었다. 연구팀은 이 장면을 특별한 순간이라고 밝혔다.

items.raw_excerpt: Fifteen minutes with a pair of clippers, a mirror check, and out the door for the price of a sandwich. Or: lying back on a reclined chair, eyes covered, a hot towel over the face, a straight razor worked slowly along the jaw, warm oil worked into the beard, a shoulder press at the end, someone offering you a coffee while you wait for the chair — forty-five minutes, and a bill that can run to three or four times the first one.
items.summary_en: A barbershop in Thailand offers two kinds of cuts. A quick trim costs about as much as a sandwich. A full hot towel shave with oil and a shoulder press takes longer and can cost three or four times more.
items.summary_ko: 태국의 한 이발소는 두 가지 이발을 제공한다. 간단한 이발은 샌드위치 값 정도로 싸다. 뜨거운 수건과 오일, 어깨 마사지까지 포함한 정식 면도는 시간이 더 걸리고 값도 세 배에서 네 배까지 비싸다.
items.title_en: Hot towel service or a simple trim?

items.raw_excerpt: Từ một cô bé say mê nghệ thuật đến Hoa hậu Thần tượng Nhí Thế giới, Nghệ sĩ nhí đa năng- Chủ nhân giải thưởng Búp Sen Vàng 2026, sân chơi do Báo Thiếu niên Tiền phong và Nhi đồng tổ chức, Lê Ngọc Minh Giang đang trở thành gương mặt nhí được chú ý khi liên tục góp mặt trên những sân khấu, chương trình Văn hóa- Nghệ thuật quy mô lớn và biểu diễn cùng nhiều tên tuổi đình đám của showbiz Việt.
items.summary_en: Le Ngoc Minh Giang is a young Vietnamese girl who loves art. She won the Bup Sen Vang 2026 award, given by a children's newspaper. Now she performs on big cultural stages with famous Vietnamese stars.

items.raw_excerpt: Top End tourism operators are calling for the creation of a dedicated fund to help struggling business survive the wet season, as they say looming cuts to holiday workers could push the sector past breaking point.
items.summary_en: Tourism operators in Australia's Northern Territory want a special fund to survive the quiet wet season. They worry that planned cuts to holiday workers could make things worse. Many small businesses fear they may have to close.

items.raw_excerpt: A new proposal would place a stadium near the next stage of light rail and within walking distance of the capital's nightlife.

items.raw_excerpt: Officials seized ₹20 lakh worth of adulterated ghee raw materials at Shiva Gayatri Milk Dairy in Ongole during a surprise inspection by Vigilance and Food Safety departments.
items.summary_en: Officials raided a milk dairy in Ongole and seized 170 kg of ghee. The ghee was said to be made with palm oil and vegetable fat instead of real milk fat. The raw materials were worth about 2 million rupees.
items.summary_ko: 당국이 옹골의 한 유제품 공장을 급습해 버터기름 170kg을 압수했다. 이 버터기름은 진짜 우유 지방 대신 팔유와 식물성 기름으로 만든 것으로 알려졌다. 압수된 원료는 약 200만 루피 상당이다.
items.title_en: 170 kg of fake ghee seized at a dairy in Ongole

items.raw_excerpt: Giữa đại ngàn Trường Sơn, làng du lịch cộng đồng Bhơ Hôồng (thôn A Păng, xã Sông Kôn, TP.Đà Nẵng) đang khoác lên mình một diện mạo mới. Những người Cơ Tu nơi đây không chỉ làm nương rẫy mà còn trở thành những người làm du lịch ngay trên quê hương mình. Từ
items.source_name: Báo và Phát thanh, Truyền hình Lạng Sơn
items.summary_en: Deep in the Truong Son mountains, the Bho Hoong community tourism village sits in Song Kon commune, Da Nang. The Co Tu people here no longer only farm; they now run tourism in their own homeland. They turned their culture into a way to earn a living.
items.summary_ko: 쯔엉선 산맥 깊은 곳, 다낭 송꼰 사의 브허호옹 공동체 관광 마을이 새 모습을 갖췄습니다. 이곳 꼬뚜족은 농사만 짓지 않고 고향에서 직접 관광을 운영합니다. 그들은 자신들의 문화를 생계 수단으로 바꿨습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: This French expression doesn't have anything to do with potatoes...
items.summary_en: A French phrase of the day explains the meaning of the idiom. Despite the word for potato inside it, the expression is not really about potatoes. It is used to describe a feeling of deep sadness or regret.
items.summary_ko: 오늘의 프랑스어 표현 시간이다. 이 표현에는 감자라는 단어가 들어 있지만, 사실 감자와는 아무 관련이 없다. 깊은 슬픔이나 후회를 나타낼 때 쓰는 말이다.

items.raw_excerpt: Loneliness is a recurring theme in online groups for foreigners in Spain, a mental health issue which is almost taboo in a country known for being sociable. The Local spoke to a Spain-based therapist to find out why.
items.summary_en: Many foreigners in Spain feel lonely, even though the country is known for being social. Online groups for expats often discuss this problem. A therapist in Spain explains why it happens.
items.summary_ko: 스페인은 사교적인 나라로 알려져 있지만, 많은 외국인이 외로움을 느낀다. 외국인 온라인 모임에서는 이 문제가 자주 이야기된다. 스페인에 있는 상담사가 그 이유를 설명한다.
items.title_en: Loneliness affects foreigners living in Spain
items.title_ko: 스페인에 사는 외국인들이 겪는 외로움
items.title_original: 'The feeling of isolation is worse': How loneliness affects foreigners in Spain
